candidates.description: This vector activates on Thai script characters, particularly combinations involving the consonant 'ม' (tho mo).
This vector represents Thai script characters, vowel markers, and sub-word letter combinations.
This feature vector represents Thai verb roots and common lexical prefixes, particularly those associated with action and work.
This feature vector represents common Thai tonal marks, vowels, and frequent subword syllable fragments.
This feature vector activates strongly on consecutive numbers within a specific numerical range.
This feature vector activates on various words and linguistic fragments related to the concept of hitting, throwing, or physical striking actions.
This feature vector represents modal verbs, auxiliary terms, and expressions of future intent, possibility, or necessity in Thai.
This feature represents global, international, or world-spanning organizations, entities, and events.
This feature vector activates strongly on numbers in the 190s and Thai script fragments commonly associated with government lottery ticket numbers.
This vector is related to character-level tokens and phonetic components predominantly found in the Thai and Korean scripts.
